name: cavemio-trend-chart
title: Trend chart
description: One metric over time, the way an analytics screen needs it: the period before as a dashed line, an unfinished day drawn dashed, a readout that glides with the pointer, and drag to zoom.

cavemio.accessibility:
- The plot is one focusable group: ←/→ move between buckets, Home and End jump to the ends, Escape lets go. Each step is announced in a polite region (date, value, the period before, the note); the pointer path isn't announced.
- Every value is also in a visually hidden table with the period before as a column.
- The line is a monotone cubic, so it never overshoots a point: a day with zero visitors never dips below the axis.
- Its height steps down in narrow containers (a container query), the tick labels thin out to fit, and labels near an edge hang inward instead of running off the card. On touch, pressing reads a bucket; the brush keeps vertical page scroll.
- Reduced motion: no reveal, morph, stretch or glide; the line, the readout and the scale change in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: buckets
props.description: – · Bucket starts in epoch ms, oldest first. Same first bucket, count and interval as before means a morph; anything else is a zoom.

props.name: previous
props.description: – · The period before, bucket for bucket. null hides the dashed line.

props.name: interval
props.description: "day" · How long one bucket is: sets the last bucket's end, the date words and the shortest span the brush takes.

props.name: kind
props.description: "count" · Counts (or money, with format); percentages from 0 to 100; or durations in seconds ("2m 41s", morphed rather than rolled).

props.name: format
props.description: { maximumFractionDigits: 0 } · How counts are written in the readout and the table. The scale writes the same format compactly (1.2K, $4.5K).

props.name: unit
props.description: – · What one value is called, after the figure: "visitors".

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: "the period before" · How the readout names the dashed line.

props.name: now
props.description: the clock at mount · A last bucket that ends after this is unfinished and drawn dashed.

props.name: onZoom
props.description: – · Called with the span dragged across, in epoch ms, snapped to bucket edges. Without it the chart can't be brushed.

props.name: note
props.description: – · A line under the figures in the readout for that bucket.

props.name: onActiveChange
props.description: – · The bucket being read, to highlight the same bucket elsewhere.

props.name: label
props.description: – · Accessible name of the chart and caption of its table.

props.name: locale
props.description: – · For dates and numbers; the viewer's own by default.

props.name: className
props.description: – · On the root. The readout's figure has data-slot="figure" for your display font.

useCases.title: Analytics overviews
useCases.description: Visitors, signups or revenue by day, with the period before beside it.

useCases.title: Product metrics
useCases.description: Daily active users or API calls, zoomed into the week something changed.

useCases.title: Billing and revenue
useCases.description: MRR or payments by week, formatted as money on the scale and in the readout.

useCases.title: Monitoring
useCases.description: Requests or latency by hour, where the current hour isn’t over yet.

features.title: Changes without jumping
features.description: New numbers on the same days morph in place; a new range stretches the old line under the new one.

features.title: The period before
features.description: Pass previous and a dashed line draws itself in, with its figure in the readout.

features.title: Unfinished buckets
features.description: A last day or hour that ends after now is drawn dashed, so a dip at the end isn’t read as a drop.

features.title: A readout that reads
features.description: Date, value, the period before and your own note line in one card that glides beside the pointer.

features.title: Drag to zoom
features.description: Drag across the chart and onZoom gets the span, snapped to whole buckets.

features.title: Keyboard and table
features.description: One tab stop with arrow keys, Home and End, each point announced, and every value in a hidden table.

states.title: arrive
states.description: The first time it has data, the line and its wash are revealed from left to right (a clip, 1100ms).

states.title: morph
states.description: New values on the same buckets (a filter): every point tweens to its new height (640ms, ease-out) and the scale's figures roll to the new round top.

states.title: zoom
states.description: New buckets (a range, a zoom, a new interval): the axis eases from the old span to the new one, so the old line stretches or shrinks to where its days sit while it fades out under the new one (640ms). The tick labels crossfade the same way. A change that lands mid-change starts from what is on screen.

states.title: compare
states.description: previous turns on: the dashed line is drawn in from the left (900ms) and fades in; it morphs with the main line after that.

states.title: hover
states.description: A thin line and a dot glide to the nearest bucket (240ms, slight overshoot); the readout card glides beside them and flips to the other side near the edge. Its date morphs letter by letter, the figure rolls, and the note line lifts the old sentence out through a blur as the new one rises in.

states.title: brush
states.description: With onZoom, pressing and dragging draws Time brush's band, snapped to bucket edges, with its first and last day and its length on a tag. Release calls onZoom; spans under one bucket are ignored. Escape cancels.

states.title: unfinished
states.description: When the last bucket ends after now, its segment is drawn dashed (3 5) in the line's colour.
